notes: Freehold c. 8 acres on Lough Corrib, Co. Galway; only structure is an old sheep pen. Not in the current islands index.
Whole island, 9.26 ha / 22.89 acres, no structures, folio MY2502F. North Clew Bay between Newport and Mulranny. Several other atlas islands share the name Roeillaun.
Freehold c. 4 acres in Dunmanus Bay, West Cork, near Durrus; no buildings. Listed on the agent's islands index without a sold marker. Atlas name Mannion's Island (Large).
10-acre Clew Bay island with a 2-bedroom off-grid house (c. 107 sq m). About 10 minutes by boat from Roy Pier, Newport. Atlas name Inishcoragh.
Entire island in the Erne at Ballyshannon harbour, with a 3-bedroom house and floating jetty. Online auction unless sold prior. Atlas name Inish Samer.
C. 4.5 acre island with a restored dwelling at the mouth of Glengarriff Harbour. Page gives a price guide and viewing by appointment, with no sold or withdrawn status.
